idea-plugin.name: Git-Aware Dev Journal
idea-plugin.description:
Git-Aware Dev Journal

Capture your development thinking as it happens. Git-Aware Dev Journal is a lightweight IDE-native journal that automatically links your notes, decisions, and TODOs to Git commits and branches — building a narrative of your work that's always in context.

Key Features

  • 6 Entry Types — Notes, Decisions, TODOs, Blockers, Insights, and Questions
  • Git Integration — Entries auto-link to current commit hash and branch
  • Auto-Capture — Automatically creates entries from conventional commit messages
  • Branch Narratives — View the complete story of a branch's development
  • Timeline View — Chronological journal with filtering by type, branch, or date
  • Search — Full-text search across all journal entries

Why Git-Aware Dev Journal?

Context switches destroy productivity. A dev journal linked to Git preserves your thought process and decisions, making it easier to resume work, hand off features, and write better pull request descriptions.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: Journaling with all entry types, Git linking, timeline view, search
  • Pro: Standup report generation, team journal sharing, branch narrative export, weekly summaries, and integration with issue trackers

action.description: Add a development journal entry at the current cursor position
